units.source_text: “我曾拼命求神灵保佑，别出现这样的情况，这大概是信心不足的缘故吧。”

en.t: I once prayed desperately for the gods to protect us, so that nothing like this would happen; I suppose it must have been because my faith was not strong enough.

units.source_text: 名人夫人于八月五日早晨对我说。

en.t: The Master's wife said this to me on the morning of August 5.
